documents.population: International applicants, Undergraduate Program Entrance Examination route
documents.notes: '2026 Undergraduate Program Entrance Examination' (online application 1 January - 28 February 2026; written examination in Chinese, English and Mathematics; enrollment September 2026): the latest PKU list published on 2026-10-19, '2026' is the cycle label. A separate 'Without Written Examination' route (detail.php?id=813) exists. Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): proof of nationality documents, certificates of award (if any), Commitment Letter for Applicants (applications without it are not accepted), self-introduction video, other supplementary materials. The written examination is a test sat at PKU, not a document.

items.quote: Proof of full-time high school education. Students expected to graduate should provide an official certificate for graduation expectation.
Transc ript of all courses completed in high school.
Application Form for Undergraduate Admission of Foreign Students at Peking University (downloaded and printed after successful online registration).
The application form must include a recent 2-inch white background color passport photo of the applicant.
All application materials must be in Chinese or English, and materials in other languages must be accompanied by notarized Chinese or English translations.
